landing.heroBadge: B2B outreach across every market you sell in
landing.heroSubtitle: Score LinkedIn prospects automatically, personalize outreach for every market, and run your whole pipeline from one place — built for teams selling across borders.
landing.problemTitle: Manual outreach doesn't scale across markets
landing.problemLead: Growing into new regions means new languages, new judgment calls on who's worth reaching, and no way to see if it's working.
landing.problem1: Every SDR searches LinkedIn by hand, so quality depends on who's doing the searching that day.
landing.problem2: Outreach messages get copy-pasted across markets, and prospects can tell.
landing.problem3: Without a shared pipeline, nobody can say which markets or messages are actually converting.
landing.productTitle: See the pipeline, not just a pitch
landing.productLead: This is a live sandbox with sample data — click around the same screens your team would use.
landing.productNote: Sample data only. Nothing here touches a real prospect.
landing.diffLead: Built around what actually breaks when a team sells into more than one market.
landing.diff1Body: Run outreach across regions from one account, each with its own market settings — not a single-country tool stretched thin.
landing.diff2Body: Messages are generated in the language of the market you're targeting, not machine-translated from a single template.
landing.diff3Body: Every lead is scored and temperature-tagged the moment it's found, so your team knows who to reach out to first.
landing.diff4Body: Every market is assigned to one rep, so no two people chase the same prospect and nothing falls through the cracks.
landing.diff5Body: Every prospect moves through the same stages from first contact to closed deal, with a full history on every card.
landing.diff6Body: Each organization's data is isolated at the database level, with a full audit trail of every change.
landing.howTitle: From zero to closed deal in 4 steps
landing.howLead: Start by picking a market. Finish by closing the deal.
landing.step1Body: Choose the region and the kind of decision-maker you're after — the system builds the search from there.
landing.step2Title: The system finds and scores them
landing.step2Body: Prospects are pulled from LinkedIn, scored against your ideal customer profile, and tagged Hot, Warm, or Cold.
landing.step3Body: Each prospect gets an outreach message written for their role, company, and language — you copy and send.
landing.step4Body: Track every reply and status change on one board, from first message to scheduled demo.
landing.plansTitle: Plans that grow with your team
landing.plansLead: Seats and monthly lead volume scale with each plan. Every plan is quoted for your team.
landing.planBasicFor: For teams starting to systemize outreach
landing.planPremiumFor: For teams scaling across multiple markets
landing.planEnterpriseFor: For larger teams with dedicated regions
landing.planUltraFor: For teams with no ceiling on volume
landing.plansPricingNote: No published pricing — every deal reflects the markets and volume you actually need. Request a demo to get a number.
landing.formLead: Tell us a bit about your team and we'll set up a walkthrough.
landing.formError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
landing.formPrivacy: We'll only use this to reach out about a demo.
landing.formSentBody: Someone from our team will reach out shortly to set up your walkthrough.
landing.footerTagline: B2B outreach for teams selling across markets.
landing.demoPipelineSubtitle: Every prospect, from first contact to closed deal
landing.demoRunSubtitle: Launch a search against your target audience
landing.demoComboDesc: CTOs, IT Directors, and Heads of Technology at mid-size companies
landing.demoRunMessageBody: Hi Chen, I noticed Nexora Semiconductor has been expanding its cloud infrastructure team — would love to share how similar teams have cut their outreach time in half. Open to a quick call this week?
landing.alsoTitle: And everything else that ships with it
landing.alsoLead: The parts of the product that don't need a demo screen to sell themselves.
landing.also1Body: Give your outreach a consistent voice — tone, target personas, and language — reused across every run and Bridge search.
landing.also2Body: Bring your own list. A guided import maps columns, checks for duplicates across your whole org, and assigns every row to the right rep.
landing.also3Body: Every closed deal keeps its conversation log, searchable later — a growing library of what actually worked.
landing.also4Body: Every status change, assignment, and edit is logged — who did what, and when.
landing.also5Body: Assign each rep to a market. New leads route automatically to whoever owns that region.
landing.also6Body: Enterprise plans can rename and recolor pipeline stages to match how your team already talks about deals.
landing.demoConvSubtitle: Every thread, with context pulled from the prospect's own company
landing.demoBridgeSubtitle: Partnership discovery — candidates grouped by company, ready for review
landing.demoAnalyticsSubtitle: Live numbers pulled straight from the pipeline above
landing.demoConvNote: Each thread is written in the prospect's own language — not machine-translated from a single template. These four are real, unedited examples in Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Vietnamese, and English.
